copy.headline: RHP Jiménez continues comeback story, agrees to Minors deal with Rangers (source)
copy.caption: Former All-Star right-hander Joe Jiménez agreed with the Rangers on a Minor League contract, a source told MLB.com's Mark Feinsand on Friday. The team has not confirmed the deal, which constitutes the conclusion of quite a journey for the veteran reliever, who missed the entirety of the 2025-26 seasons.
